lsfg-vk-android (GameNative, https://github.com/GameNative/lsfg-vk-android, release branch, commit 437208a), MIT:
LICENSE.md. tools/lsfg/lsfg_smrpg.cpp takes from its layer the resource table of extract.cpp, the translation of trans.cpp
and the mipmap shader (mipmaps_replacement); the rest of its code is not in this repository: tools/lsfg/build.sh compiles
it from a separate clone (../deps/src/lsfg-vk-android, or LSFG_SRC).
